title: Short- and long-term effects of structured one-day or two-day extracorporeal resuscitation simulation training on team performance, decision making and workplace satisfaction – a multicenter study
summary: This study investigates the effects of structured one-day versus two-day extracorporeal resuscitation (ECPR) simulation training on team performance, decision-making and communication. Participants complete simulations and questionnaires before and after training.

interventions.name: One-day structured simulation training course on extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation (ECPR) with extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO). Two-day structured simulation training in extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation (ECPR) with extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO). Same kind of participants, time points, and parameters as in Arm 1, but with extended training exposure.

criteria:
